OVERRIDE_FLAGS.bloom_intensity: Controls bloom post-process intensity per role (0.0-1.0). Set per-material-instance on PPV_NikkiDream.
OVERRIDE_FLAGS.vignette_intensity: Controls vignette post-process intensity per role (0.0-1.0). Set per-material-instance on PPV_NikkiDream.
OVERRIDE_FLAGS.film_grain_intensity: Controls film grain post-process intensity per role (0.0-1.0). Set per-material-instance on PPV_NikkiDream.
OVERRIDE_FLAGS.scene_fringe_intensity: Controls chromatic aberration post-process intensity per role (0.0-1.0). Set per-material-instance on PPV_NikkiDream.
OVERRIDE_FLAGS.ink_react: InkReact scalar parameter on MPC_MelodiaInk. Drives liveliness of ink render effect.
OVERRIDE_FLAGS.ink_master_weight: InkMasterWeight scalar parameter on MPC_MelodiaInk. Controls overall ink darkness intensity.
OVERRIDE_FLAGS.storybook_outline_weight: Weight of M_PP_StorybookOutline blendable in PPV_NikkiDream weighted_blendables stack.
OVERRIDE_FLAGS.melusina_grade_weight: Weight of M_PP_MeluColorGrade blendable in PPV_NikkiDream weighted_blendables stack (canonical 0.69).
